knownAmbiguitiesOrLimitations: The notification names Commonwealth Games, World Cups and World Championships but does not prescribe an internal weighting. This file uses four balanced subtopics with 10 questions each.
The current date is after Glasgow 2026. Questions about Glasgow use completed-event wording and the official 2026 event page; historical questions retain their event year.
FIFA's 2026 final location is styled by FIFA as New York New Jersey; the option preserves that official naming rather than choosing one municipality.
The source catalog currently lacks these granular event sources. The source suggestions above are limited to pages actually inspected and should be added centrally before the merged-bank validation.
The question bank uses original concise MCQ wording rather than reproducing a specific copyrighted question-bank item verbatim.
